history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.description: In the breeders-x4 and breeders-x8 worlds on borg-reborn-rs 296adfbf (PR #891), do the switches of #878 (attack on sight on a lone slow monster with the best ranged attack; the Phase Door verdict and the reserve spell read the danger without fear; no reserve cast that faints; the unseen-bump Phase only when fresh or dangerous; the breeder melee bonus 5) save the white worm mass games they were written for, where the normal world shows only a few such games? Each world has its own control. Generated from definitions/reborn-lone-slow-worlds-pilot.yaml: 10 arms on 4.2.6-reborn-rust-lone-slow-worlds-296adfbf, suite classes-18.
experiment.name: reborn-lone-slow-worlds-pilot
experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-22: zoo owner, "yes do it" (the breeder-world pilots of #626, the scenario companion #678; RULES 21).
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-22, before any game of this build was played in these worlds (borg-zoo#678, companion of #626; RULES 21). Five arms (the requester's short
list: ctl, lone, phase-nofear, breeder5, all) in breeders-x4 and in breeders-x8 (10 profiles), classes-18, 18 starts each (180 cells), 100,000 turns,
evidence retained. A world's arms are compared only within that world (ctl-x4 against x4 arms, ctl-x8 against x8 arms). Gate: no config_error; one binary;
every cell records its world with the same borg_world_data_sha256 in every arm of that world; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in
death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls apart; identical plays. Report per world, arm and class: deaths and causes (breeders and poison apart), CL and
DL, paired rescued and newly killed against the world's ctl; per arm Phase Doors read, retreats and back-ups next to a breeder, reserve-spell casts and
faints, the "(lone and slow ...) (#878)" notes. A breeder world is a stress test: a lead here needs the normal-world tiers of #626 (small + medium +
big, already run) before a shipped value changes. Directional (RULES 14).

Each world has its own control.
